The transaction was an online purchase for product R conducted from device D007135, which was new to the account. Graph analysis revealed that device D007135 was recently used by another card, C07196-K2, for near-identical purchases and is tied to three prior confirmed fraud cases. sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report documents confirmed card-not-present fraud identified on card C08318-K1 under customer C08318. On 2016-12-14 at 13:41:14 UTC, unauthorized online transaction 3541817 in the amount of $450.09 for product R was executed in billing region 126. The transaction was initiated using device D007135, profiled as a Windows 10 system running Edge 16.0 (resolution 1365x768), which was recorded as new to the account. Internal model monitoring flagged the transaction with a model score of 0.993, representing a 92.1 percent historical fraud rate. Knowledge graph analysis identified that device D007135 was concurrently used on 2016-12-12 on card C07196-K2 to conduct matching transaction 3536052 for $450.06 for product R. In addition, device D007135 is linked to three prior closed confirmed fraud cases, CC-5329, CC-5557, and CC-5430, involving card C06224-K2. Cardholder C08318 had no prior established transaction history or baseline with device D007135. The execution of near-identical transactions across multiple unrelated cards from the same device demonstrates deliberate and unauthorized card-not-present activity. Total fraudulent exposure resulting from this transaction is $450.09. The bank has blocked card C08318-K1 to prevent further losses, placed connected card C07196-K2 on heightened monitoring, and filed this report.
